videos.headline: South Carolina celebrates clinching Final Four spot over Duke
videos.description: South Carolina celebrates as time expires in its 54-50 victory over Duke in the Elite Eight.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (South Carolina celebrates clinching Final Four spot over Duke) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Raven Johnson feeds the post for 2
videos.description: Sania Feagin catches a nice feed from Raven Johnson to get the post bucket.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Raven Johnson feeds the post for 2) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Chloe Kitts hits an early 3
videos.description: Te-Hina Paopao draws the defense and kicks to an open Chloe Kitts for 3.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Chloe Kitts hits an early 3) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Toby Fournier scores 5 quick points for Duke
videos.description: Toby Fournier pulls Duke back into the game with a layup and 3-pointer for Duke.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Toby Fournier scores 5 quick points for Duke) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: MiLaysia Fulwiley shows off her handles on the midrange J
videos.description: MiLaysia Fulwiley flashes handles to create some space, then hits a midrange jumper for the Gamecocks.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (MiLaysia Fulwiley shows off her handles on the midrange J) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Fournier, Jackson get Blue Devils back into the game
videos.description: Ashlon Jackson dimes Toby Fournier on the fast break, then hits a 3 to get Duke to within 3 of South Carolina.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Fournier, Jackson get Blue Devils back into the game) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Fulwiley capitalizes on a Duke turnover
videos.description: Tessa Johnson steals the rock from Duke, then MiLaysia Fulwiley gets a nice reverse layup to go.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Fulwiley capitalizes on an SC steal) 2025/03/30 ESHEET

videos.headline: Ashlon Jackson's 3 puts Duke up 5
videos.description: Ashlon Jackson cashes a big 3-pointer for Duke over South Carolina.

videos.headline: South Carolina's Staley: 'We fought our way in' to Final Four
videos.description: Dawn Staley says the Gamecocks "really weren't supposed to be here" but never gave up on defending their national championship in the Final Four.
